newsitem.title: USA: RehabCare Group Q3 net up on new business.
newsitem.headline: RehabCare Group Q3 net up on new business.

text.p: RehabCare Group Inc said Thursday net income in the third quarter, which ended November 30, totaled $1.9 million versus $1.4 million a year ago.
The company said operating revenues reached $31.5 million, compared to $22.4 million in the third quarter of fiscal 1995.

"The third quarter results reflect a number of very positive factors," James Usdan, RehabCare Group's president and chief executive officer said, "including progress in accelerating the pace of new business development."
Its shares closed up 1/4 Thursday at 19-5/8.
